title: India’s Top Court Orders Inquiry Into Student Protest Crackdown
title_cn: 印度最高法院下令调查镇压学生抗议活动
summary: India’s top court has ordered a probe into police action against students during last month’s youth demonstrations, which led a minister to resign from Prime Minister Narendra Modi’s cabinet.

title: CFTC's Selig Says Clarity Act Gives Crypto Clear Rules
title_cn: CFTC 的 Selig 表示《清晰法案》为加密货币制定了明确的规则
summary: Commodity Futures Trading Commission Chairman Michael Selig says the crypto industry will get market structure rules even if Congress does not pass the so-called Clarity Act. Selig says he's optimistic the bill will pass, but regulators are ready to act if it doesn't. He speaks to Bloomberg's Tyler Kendall. (Source: Bloomberg)
